card.name: Last digit of a percentage in parentheses
card.fires_on: Digits inside a percentage figure in parentheses, just before the % sign and closing bracket. Common in adverse-event rates and comparisons with placebo.

modes.label: Decimal digit in a rate
modes.description: The digit after the decimal point in a percentage inside parentheses, often the second figure in a comparison.

card.plain: It fires on the last digit of a percentage in brackets, where the next thing is the % sign and a closing parenthesis.
